text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (October 22, 2025) for 3 Claxton Boulevard.

The Property Standards Committee, Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (October 22, 2025) for 3 Claxton Boulevard, Folder Number: 25 243151 PRS 00 IV, and in doing so granted an extension of time to February 28, 2027.
